verdict.rationale: The only tangential evidence is a passing mention of 'JetBrains' in a list of integrations alongside git hosts and chat tools (cursor-docs-6), with no detail on an actual JetBrains plugin, interactive diff viewer, or in-IDE context-sharing feature. Cursor is documented primarily as its own VSCode-fork IDE with terminal/CLI and Slack/GitHub integrations, not as a JetBrains plugin experience.
